newsitem.title: USA: "Change the World" wins best song Grammy.
newsitem.headline: "Change the World" wins best song Grammy.

text.p: "Change the World," by songwriters Gordon Kennedy, Wayne Kirkpatrick and Tommy Sims, won the song of the year Grammy award on Wednesday.
Earlier in the gala awards ceremony, rock guitarist Eric Clapton won a Grammy as best male pop vocalist for his rendition of the song, a blend of rhythm and blues and rock.
